objective: Expose the existing thesis-by-thesis earnings renderer as one explicit offline workbench job over an operator-frozen historical input pack.
non_goals: No live collection, scheduling, model-provider calls, automated thesis verdict, U4 approval, paper registration, trading, or production installation.
dependencies: ar.workflow-trial.v1 frozen request and source-hash contract
input_contracts: Operator fixes a read-only pack root at startup containing requests/earnings-<ts_code>.json and inputs/.
Every request must be HISTORICAL_REPLAY/earnings and filename identity must equal the payload company; original source bytes must match declared SHA256.
output_artifacts: Workbench job event with per-company readable reports and pending-review receipts
Dedicated nonproduction earnings-trials directory containing original trial files and SHA256SUMS per company
acceptance_tests: Changed source bytes, synthetic mode, wrong identity, missing evidence and scheduling must not succeed; unchanged historical inputs reproduce renderer report bytes.
approval_gates: Draft PR and independent review before merge.
Keep #383 Draft; this PR does not authorize its merge.
No production installation, data transfer, team grant or paid API activation is implied.
